author: Kushal
problem: A patio is laid from tiles square tiles of the same size, arranged as a full rectangle. Return how many different rectangle shapes are possible, counting a shape and its rotation once (so 6 tiles give 1x6 and 2x3).
bug_description: Loops while w * w < tiles instead of <=, so when tiles is a perfect square the square layout is never counted.

comments.accurate: Counts the distinct rectangles the tiles can form, ignoring rotation
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts the distinct non-square rectangles the tiles can form, ignoring rotation
comments.wrong_location: Loop limit checked; the divisibility test may count some shapes twice
